methodology: Editorial prominence, not a scientific index: tiers summarise selected political reach, exchange networks and lasting institutional or cultural effects. Height remains chronological duration. Context frames receive less weight to avoid duplicating concurrent named histories. Tier differences do not rank peoples or cultures in human worth. Sources support the historical narratives; neither museums nor historians supplied these numerical weights. Phase multipliers are deliberately coarse illustrative visual choices, not measured shares of territory, population or GDP. Phase boundaries can reflect conventional events, reigns or broad narrative anchors; they do not date every local change.
